name: 29341 · Gaffney, SC
findings: ZIP 29341 (Gaffney) has 33 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 29341 (Gaffney) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 29341 (Gaffney) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 59% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.
